testcase.system-out: Scenario: Filter model browser entries by name ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-points.opd` is open in the MCAD Software with multiple work points and other features ✔ And the model browser is visible ✔ When the user opens the browser search field ✔ And the user enters "InspectionPoint" ✔ Then InspectionPointA, InspectionPointB and InspectionPointC are shown in the browser ✔ And the matching text is highlighted in those rows ✔ And unrelated visible feature rows are filtered from the browser ✔ And the model remains displayed in the viewport ✔ When the user activates the search field close control ✔ Then the search text is cleared ✔ And the unfiltered browser tree is shown again ✔ When the user activates the close control again ✔ Then the browser search field is hidden
